subject: general
question: According to the exercise brief published by PIB, from 10–23 March 2025, Exercise Khanjar‑XII, the Joint Special Forces Drill between India and Kyrgyzstan focused primarily on:
solution:
The correct answer is __**counter-terrorism**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Exercise Khanjar:** It is a **Joint Special Forces Military Drill** conducted between **India** and **Kyrgyzstan.** This exercise aims to strengthen military cooperation and enhance interoperability between the two nations.
 
• **Focus of Khanjar-XII:** The 12th edition of Exercise Khanjar, conducted from **10–23 March 2025**, focused primarily on **counter-terrorism operations.**__ This reflects the ongoing commitment of both nations to combat terrorism and enhance regional security.
 
• The exercise included **joint training** sessions on **combat tactics, high-altitude operations, urban warfare, and hostage rescue missions.** These are crucial elements of counter-terrorism operations.
 
• The **participation of Special Forces** units from both countries highlights the emphasis on specialized training and the role of elite forces in counter-terrorism strategies.
 
• The focus on **counter-terrorism** aligns with the global and regional security challenges faced by both nations, particularly in Central Asia, which has witnessed an increase in terror-related activities in recent years.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is counter-terrorism.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Exercise Khanjar:**

 
 
• The exercise was first initiated in **2011** to foster defense cooperation and mutual understanding between **India** and **Kyrgyzstan.**
 
• It is held alternately in the two countries and focuses on **tactical drills, counter-terrorism techniques, and disaster management operations.**
 
 
 
• **Counter-Terrorism Training:**
 
 
• Counter-terrorism operations require specialized skills such as **intelligence gathering, surveillance, hostage rescue, and neutralization of threats.**
 
• The training emphasizes **urban warfare, high-altitude operations, and the use of modern technology** to combat terrorism effectively.
 
 
 
• **India-Kyrgyzstan Defense Cooperation:**
 
 
• India and Kyrgyzstan share strong defense ties, with both nations committed to ensuring regional security and stability.
 
• The **Kyrgyzstan-India Mountain Biomedical Research Center** is another example of their collaboration in the defense sector.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Options Explained:**

 
 
• **Amphibious Warfare:** This involves operations conducted on both land and water, typically not a focus area of Exercise Khanjar.
 
• **Air Defense Operations:** These operations involve protecting airspace against hostile threats, which is not the primary objective of Exercise Khanjar.
 
• **Naval Fleet Manoeuvres:** This pertains to naval exercises and the movement of warships, which is unrelated to this land-based exercise.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Counter-Terrorism Operations:**
 
 
• Counter-terrorism is critical for maintaining **regional stability** and ensuring the **safety of civilians** against extremist threats.
 
• Exercises like Khanjar enhance **preparedness** and equip forces with the latest skills to combat evolving threats.
